tasks.title: Define lead qualification criteria and tools
tasks.description: Establish clear criteria for what constitutes a qualified lead, including decision-maker contact, budget authority, and specific pain points. Select and configure tools for lead tracking and scoring.
tasks.done_criteria: Lead qualification criteria and tools are documented and shared with the sales team.

tasks.title: Prepare lead generation templates and outreach materials
tasks.description: Create templates for outreach emails, LinkedIn messages, and cold calls. Include value propositions tailored to Vietnamese SMEs in the HR software space.
tasks.done_criteria: Templates and outreach materials are ready for use by the sales team.

tasks.title: Conduct 5 cold outreach calls
tasks.description: Make 5 cold calls to potential leads in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, using the prepared templates. Focus on identifying qualified leads and scheduling follow-up meetings.
tasks.done_criteria: 5 cold calls completed, with notes on each lead's qualification status.

tasks.title: Conduct another 5 cold outreach calls
tasks.description: Make another 5 cold calls to potential leads in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, using the prepared templates. Focus on identifying qualified leads and scheduling follow-up meetings.
tasks.done_criteria: Another 5 cold calls completed, with notes on each lead's qualification status.

tasks.title: Conduct another 5 cold outreach calls
tasks.description: Make another 5 cold calls to potential leads in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, using the prepared templates. Focus on identifying qualified leads and scheduling follow-up meetings.
tasks.done_criteria: Another 5 cold calls completed, with notes on each lead's qualification status.

tasks.title: Review and refine outreach strategy based on feedback
tasks.description: Analyze the results of the 15 calls, identify what worked and what didn't, and refine the outreach strategy for future calls.
tasks.done_criteria: Outreach strategy is refined based on feedback from the first 15 calls.

tasks.title: Conduct 5 follow-up calls and meetings
tasks.description: Follow up with the 5 qualified leads from the first round, and reach out to additional leads identified during the outreach phase. Focus on building relationships and moving leads through the sales pipeline.
tasks.done_criteria: 5 follow-up calls and meetings completed, with notes on each lead's progress.

tasks.title: Conduct another 5 follow-up calls and meetings
tasks.description: Follow up with the 5 qualified leads from the second round, and reach out to additional leads identified during the outreach phase. Focus on building relationships and moving leads through the sales pipeline.
tasks.done_criteria: Another 5 follow-up calls and meetings completed, with notes on each lead's progress.

tasks.title: Conduct another 5 follow-up calls and meetings
tasks.description: Follow up with the 5 qualified leads from the third round, and reach out to additional leads identified during the outreach phase. Focus on building relationships and moving leads through the sales pipeline.
tasks.done_criteria: Another 5 follow-up calls and meetings completed, with notes on each lead's progress.

tasks.title: Measure and report on qualified leads per month
tasks.description: Track the number of qualified leads generated during the quarter, and report on progress toward the target of 45 leads per month.
tasks.done_criteria: Qualified leads per month are measured and reported, with a mid-quarter and end-of-quarter review.

tasks.title: Define target companies and contracts
tasks.description: Identify and define the list of potential Vietnamese SMEs in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City that are likely to sign annual contracts.
tasks.done_criteria: List of 20+ target companies with basic contact details and industry alignment.

tasks.title: Prepare sales materials and templates
tasks.description: Create and finalize sales pitch, contract templates, and value proposition documents tailored for Vietnamese SMEs.
tasks.done_criteria: Sales materials and contract templates are ready for use.

tasks.title: Cold outreach to 10 target companies
tasks.description: Reach out to 10 pre-selected companies via email and LinkedIn to introduce the product and schedule initial calls.
tasks.done_criteria: 10 outreach emails sent and 5 initial calls scheduled.

tasks.title: Cold outreach to another 10 target companies
tasks.description: Reach out to another 10 pre-selected companies via email and LinkedIn to introduce the product and schedule initial calls.
tasks.done_criteria: 10 outreach emails sent and 5 initial calls scheduled.

tasks.title: Conduct 5 initial calls with potential clients
tasks.description: Schedule and conduct 5 initial calls with potential clients to understand their needs and present the product.
tasks.done_criteria: 5 initial calls completed with notes on each client's interest and pain points.

tasks.title: Conduct another 5 initial calls with potential clients
tasks.description: Schedule and conduct another 5 initial calls with potential clients to understand their needs and present the product.
tasks.done_criteria: 5 initial calls completed with notes on each client's interest and pain points.

tasks.title: Follow-up with 10 leads and schedule demos
tasks.description: Follow up with 10 leads from initial calls, schedule product demos, and prepare tailored proposals.
tasks.done_criteria: 10 follow-up emails sent, 5 demos scheduled, and 5 proposals prepared.

tasks.title: Conduct 5 product demos with interested leads
tasks.description: Conduct 5 product demos with interested leads and finalize the contracts for 5 of them.
tasks.done_criteria: 5 product demos completed and 5 contracts signed.

tasks.title: Measure and report on new contracts signed
tasks.description: Track and report the number of new annual contracts signed, comparing to the baseline and target.
tasks.done_criteria: Report on 5 new contracts signed, with metrics and progress toward the target of 8.

tasks.title: Define criteria for higher-value deals
tasks.description: Identify what makes a deal qualify as higher-value (e.g., larger company size, more complex needs, longer contract term).
tasks.done_criteria: Criteria document finalized and shared with the sales team.

tasks.title: Prepare a deal size tracking template
tasks.description: Create a template to track deal size, including metrics like average deal size, number of deals, and revenue per deal.
tasks.done_criteria: Template created and shared with the sales team.

tasks.title: Conduct 6 calls with high-value leads
tasks.description: Schedule and conduct calls with 6 high-value leads to understand their needs and identify opportunities for larger deals.
tasks.done_criteria: 6 calls completed and notes documented.

tasks.title: Review and refine deal size tracking template
tasks.description: Review the template with the sales team and refine it based on feedback and real-world data.
tasks.done_criteria: Template finalized and approved by the sales team.

tasks.title: Implement a deal size tracking process
tasks.description: Introduce the tracking process to the sales team and ensure it is used consistently across all deals.
tasks.done_criteria: Tracking process implemented and confirmed by the sales team.

tasks.title: Measure baseline average deal size
tasks.description: Calculate the current average deal size using the tracking template and CRM data.
tasks.done_criteria: Baseline average deal size calculated and documented.

tasks.title: Conduct 6 follow-up calls with high-value leads
tasks.description: Schedule and conduct follow-up calls with the same 6 high-value leads to close larger deals.
tasks.done_criteria: 6 follow-up calls completed and notes documented.

tasks.title: Track and report on deal size progress
tasks.description: Track the average deal size during the quarter and report progress to the team.
tasks.done_criteria: Progress report submitted with updated average deal size.

tasks.title: Measure final average deal size
tasks.description: Calculate the final average deal size using the tracking template and CRM data.
tasks.done_criteria: Final average deal size calculated and documented.

tasks.title: Define the sales playbook structure and scope
tasks.description: Outline the structure of the sales playbook, including stages, key activities, and required tools. Define the scope of the playbook to ensure it covers the entire sales process from lead generation to closing.
tasks.done_criteria: A draft structure and scope document is completed and shared with the sales team.

tasks.title: Gather and organize sales process data
tasks.description: Collect data on current sales activities, including lead sources, follow-up steps, and closing techniques. Organize this data into a structured format for the playbook.
tasks.done_criteria: A structured dataset of current sales activities is compiled and ready for playbook development.

tasks.title: Draft the sales playbook content
tasks.description: Write the content for the sales playbook, including step-by-step processes, templates, and tools. Ensure it is clear and actionable for the sales team.
tasks.done_criteria: A complete draft of the sales playbook is created and reviewed internally.

tasks.title: Test the playbook with a small group of sales reps
tasks.description: Conduct a trial run of the playbook with a small group of sales reps to gather feedback and identify areas for improvement.
tasks.done_criteria: Feedback from the trial group is collected and documented.

tasks.title: Revise the playbook based on feedback
tasks.description: Revise the playbook based on the feedback received during the trial run. Ensure all improvements are incorporated into the final version.
tasks.done_criteria: The final version of the playbook is ready for full team adoption.

tasks.title: Present and roll out the playbook to the sales team
tasks.description: Present the final version of the playbook to the entire sales team and provide training on its use. Ensure all team members understand and adopt the process.
tasks.done_criteria: The playbook is presented, and the sales team has completed training on its use.

tasks.title: Measure adoption and effectiveness of the playbook
tasks.description: Track the adoption of the playbook by the sales team and measure its effectiveness in improving sales processes and outcomes.
tasks.done_criteria: Adoption and effectiveness of the playbook are measured and reported.

tasks.title: Define CRM data completeness criteria
tasks.description: Identify which fields are required for CRM data completeness and set clear criteria for what constitutes a complete record.
tasks.done_criteria: List of required fields and criteria for completeness defined and shared with the team.

tasks.title: Audit current CRM data completeness
tasks.description: Review existing CRM records to assess the current level of data completeness and identify gaps.
tasks.done_criteria: Audit report showing current data completeness level and gaps identified.

tasks.title: Create a data completeness checklist
tasks.description: Develop a checklist that sales team members can use to ensure all required fields are filled when entering CRM data.
tasks.done_criteria: Checklist document with all required fields and instructions for use.

tasks.title: Train the sales team on data completeness
tasks.description: Conduct a training session to ensure the sales team understands the importance of data completeness and how to use the checklist.
tasks.done_criteria: Training session completed and team members confirmed they understand the checklist and its use.

tasks.title: Implement data completeness tracking
tasks.description: Set up a system to track data completeness over time, including regular checks and reporting.
tasks.done_criteria: Tracking system in place with regular checks and reporting schedule defined.

tasks.title: Monitor and improve data completeness
tasks.description: Continuously monitor CRM data completeness, identify areas for improvement, and implement changes to increase completeness to 90%.
tasks.done_criteria: CRM data completeness reaches 90% and a report showing progress and improvements is submitted.
